capabilities: Edit parameter values inline in Live Preview and Reading mode
Substitute matching references throughout the current tab
Copy resolved commands through native code-block copy buttons
Maintain saved defaults in frontmatter via a collapsible panel
Migrate legacy doc-vars comments into frontmatter definitions
extras: Desktop-only MVP (requires Obsidian 1.13.7+); mobile, pop-out windows, and transclusions are unsupported. Performs no command execution, shell escaping, network requests, or telemetry; values are substituted literally, so the author must supply quoting. Installable manually, via the community listing, or through BRAT.
problem: Obsidian has no way to fill a placeholder value once and have every reference in prose, inline code, and command blocks update for copying.

relations.evidence: With Copy Inline Code 2.1.0 installed, its existing inline copy icon also copies resolved values.

summary: Parameter system that defines named variables in a note, fills their values inline per tab, and copies code blocks with substituted values.
